description:
About our brand and products: Just Like Kandy is a luxury self-care brand offering indulgent body care designed to leave skin soft, glowing, and addictive to touch.

What makes us different: We combine luxurious fragrances, beautiful presentation, and handcrafted self-care experiences customers want to enjoy again and again.

How affiliates can earn: Earn commission by sharing Just Like Kandy products with your audience through your unique affiliate link or code.

How to promote us: Create authentic social media content, product reviews, tutorials, unboxings, routines, and lifestyle content featuring your favorite JLK products.

Other information: We’re looking for creative affiliates who genuinely love beauty, body care, fragrance, and luxurious self-care.
payout_period: Affiliate commissions are paid monthly on the 15th for all approved commissions earned during the previous month. Commissions are subject to a 30-day validation period to account for returns, refunds, or canceled orders.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Just Like Kandy! We’re excited to have you join our Affiliate Program and become part of the Kandy Family.

These Terms and Conditions apply to individuals participating in the Just Like Kandy Affiliate Program (“Program”). Throughout these Terms, Just Like Kandy may be referred to as “we,” “us,” “our,” “Merchant,” or “JLK,” and the individual participating in the Program may be referred to as “you” or “Affiliate.”

By registering for or participating in the Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you may not register for or participate in the Program.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

All applications to the Just Like Kandy Affiliate Program are subject to review and approval.

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program application at our sole discretion. Submission of an application does not guarantee acceptance into the Program.

We may consider factors including, but not limited to, social media presence, content quality, audience engagement, brand alignment, promotional methods, and the information provided on your application.

Participation in the Program is a privilege and may be revoked in accordance with these Terms and Conditions.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

Approved Affiliates will receive a unique affiliate link and may also receive a unique promotional or coupon code.

Affiliates may use their affiliate link to direct customers to the Just Like Kandy website or generate links to specific products or collections when this functionality is available.

Our tracking system generally attributes a referral according to the applicable tracking settings within the Program. If a customer interacts with multiple affiliate links, the referral credited by our affiliate tracking system will determine which Affiliate receives the commission.

Affiliates may only promote coupon codes that have been specifically assigned or authorized by Just Like Kandy. Affiliates may not create, advertise, distribute, or promote unauthorized discount codes or represent expired codes as active.

If a customer uses an Affiliate's link and coupon code for the same transaction, the Affiliate will not receive duplicate commissions.

Unless specifically authorized by Just Like Kandy, Affiliate codes may not be submitted to coupon websites, deal websites, discount databases, browser extensions, cashback websites, or similar third-party platforms.

Affiliate links and coupon codes are intended to generate legitimate customer referrals. Affiliates may not manipulate the tracking system or use their affiliate link or coupon code in a fraudulent or misleading manner.

Self-referrals or purchases made primarily for the purpose of generating Affiliate commission may be reviewed and may be excluded from commission eligibility at Just Like Kandy's discretion.

3. Commissions and Payment

Approved Affiliates will earn a 15% commission on qualifying referral sales made through their unique affiliate link or authorized coupon code.

The Program currently provides a 30-day cookie tracking period.

Commission is calculated on the qualifying product subtotal actually paid by the customer after applicable discounts. Unless otherwise stated by Just Like Kandy, commission is not earned on taxes, shipping charges, gift cards, refunded amounts, canceled orders, chargebacks, returned merchandise, or other non-product charges.

Affiliates must provide accurate and complete payment information within their Affiliate account before receiving commission payments.

Commissions are only payable on successfully completed and verified transactions.

Just Like Kandy reserves the right to review referral transactions before approving commissions. Transactions suspected of fraud, manipulation, self-referral abuse, duplicate attribution, unauthorized coupon distribution, or other violations of these Terms may be denied.

If a commission has already been credited or paid on an order that is later refunded, canceled, charged back, determined to be fraudulent, or otherwise deemed ineligible, Just Like Kandy reserves the right to reverse the commission or deduct the applicable amount from future commissions where permitted by law.

Affiliate commission status may be viewed through the Affiliate portal.

Affiliates are responsible for providing any tax information or documentation that may be legally required and are responsible for their own federal, state, and local tax obligations associated with Affiliate earnings.

4. Marketing Tools and Brand Materials

Just Like Kandy may provide Affiliates with approved marketing materials, including product photographs, promotional graphics, banners, logos, videos, product information, campaign materials, and other brand assets.

These materials are provided solely for the purpose of promoting Just Like Kandy through the Affiliate Program.

Affiliates may create their own original content featuring Just Like Kandy products; however, all content must accurately represent the products and remain consistent with the Just Like Kandy brand.

Affiliates may not alter the Just Like Kandy logo, product labels, packaging, trademarks, product names, photographs, or other proprietary materials in a manner that misrepresents the brand.

Affiliates may not represent themselves as Just Like Kandy, an employee of Just Like Kandy, or an official company spokesperson.

Just Like Kandy retains all ownership rights to its trademarks, logos, product names, photographs, graphics, website content, and other intellectual property.

Participation in the Affiliate Program does not transfer ownership of any Just Like Kandy intellectual property to the Affiliate.

5. Advertising and Promotional Guidelines

Affiliates are encouraged to share Just Like Kandy through appropriate channels, including social media, websites, blogs, email, video content, and other approved promotional platforms.

Affiliate promotions must be truthful, professional, and consistent with the image and values of Just Like Kandy.

Affiliates may not engage in spam, deceptive advertising, false advertising, misleading promotions, impersonation, unsolicited mass messaging, or other promotional activities that could damage the reputation of Just Like Kandy.

Affiliates may not purchase fake followers, fake engagement, fake reviews, or otherwise misrepresent their audience, reach, engagement, or relationship with Just Like Kandy.

Unless written permission is provided by Just Like Kandy, Affiliates may not purchase paid search advertisements or bid on Just Like Kandy's business name, product names, trademarks, misspellings of trademarks, or other branded search terms.

Affiliates may not create social media accounts, websites, domains, usernames, or advertising accounts that could reasonably cause a consumer to believe the account is owned or operated by Just Like Kandy.

Just Like Kandy reserves the right to request the removal or correction of Affiliate content that violates these guidelines or inaccurately represents the brand.

6. Product Claims and Representations

Affiliates must accurately describe Just Like Kandy products and may only make product claims that are supported or specifically authorized by Just Like Kandy.

Affiliates may share their genuine personal experiences and opinions about products, provided those statements are truthful and not misleading.

Affiliates may not claim or imply that a Just Like Kandy cosmetic or body-care product diagnoses, treats, cures, prevents, or mitigates a disease or medical condition unless Just Like Kandy has expressly authorized the specific claim and the claim is legally permitted and appropriately substantiated.

This includes unauthorized claims concerning conditions such as eczema, psoriasis, acne, infections, or other medical or dermatological conditions.

Affiliates are responsible for ensuring that their promotional content does not contain false, exaggerated, deceptive, or unsubstantiated statements about Just Like Kandy products.

7. Affiliate Disclosures and FTC Compliance

Affiliates must clearly disclose their financial relationship with Just Like Kandy whenever promoting products through affiliate links, coupon codes, gifted products, paid collaborations, or other arrangements requiring disclosure.

Disclosures must be clear, noticeable, and placed where consumers can reasonably see or hear them.

Appropriate disclosures may include statements such as “#ad,” “#affiliate,” “I earn commission from qualifying purchases,” or other clear language identifying the Affiliate's relationship with Just Like Kandy.

Affiliates are responsible for complying with applicable Federal Trade Commission (FTC) endorsement and advertising requirements and any applicable platform-specific disclosure rules.

A disclosure should not be hidden among hashtags or placed where a reasonable consumer is unlikely to notice it.

8. Network and Affiliate Referrals

If the Network feature is activated within the Just Like Kandy Affiliate Program, eligible Affiliates may be permitted to invite others to apply to the Program using an authorized network referral link.

If an approved downline Affiliate generates qualifying sales, an eligible upline Affiliate may receive network commission according to the commission structure established by Just Like Kandy at that time.

Network participation, commission rates, eligibility, and availability are determined solely by Just Like Kandy and may be modified or discontinued.

Affiliates may not make income guarantees or misleading earnings claims when inviting others to apply to the Program.

If the Network feature is not active, this section does not apply.

9. Cookies and Referral Tracking

The Just Like Kandy Affiliate Program currently uses a 30-day cookie period for eligible affiliate referrals.

When a potential customer clicks an Affiliate's unique referral link, a tracking cookie may be placed on the customer's browser or device.

Customers must allow the technologies necessary for referral tracking. If a customer blocks cookies, deletes cookies, uses certain privacy tools, changes devices or browsers, or otherwise prevents the tracking system from identifying the referral, Just Like Kandy may be unable to attribute the transaction to an Affiliate.

Just Like Kandy cannot guarantee commission for transactions that cannot be accurately tracked by the Affiliate Program's technology.

Referral attribution is determined by the tracking system and Program settings in effect at the time of the transaction.

10. Returns, Refunds, Cancellations and Chargebacks

Affiliate commission is earned only on eligible, completed sales.

Orders that are canceled, fully refunded, charged back, determined to be fraudulent, or otherwise invalid will not qualify for commission.

If only a portion of an order is refunded or returned, the corresponding Affiliate commission may be adjusted accordingly.

If commission associated with an ineligible transaction has already been credited or paid, Just Like Kandy reserves the right to reverse that commission or deduct the applicable amount from future Affiliate earnings where permitted by law.

11. Affiliate Content and Permission to Share

Affiliates retain ownership of original photographs, videos, written content, and other materials they independently create unless otherwise agreed in writing.

When an Affiliate tags, mentions, submits, or directly provides Just Like Kandy with Affiliate content for promotional consideration, Just Like Kandy may request permission to repost, share, or feature that content through its website, social media channels, email marketing, or other promotional platforms.

Any broader advertising or commercial usage rights may be addressed separately when appropriate.

Affiliates may not use content belonging to another creator without the appropriate permission.

12. Independent Affiliate Relationship

Participation in the Just Like Kandy Affiliate Program does not create an employer-employee, partnership, franchise, joint venture, agency, or other employment relationship between Just Like Kandy and the Affiliate.

Affiliates participate as independent individuals or businesses and are responsible for their own activities, expenses, equipment, business obligations, and taxes.

Affiliates do not have authority to enter into agreements, make commitments, incur obligations, or make representations on behalf of Just Like Kandy.

Participation in the Program does not guarantee any minimum amount of income, sales, commissions, products, opportunities, or continued participation.

13. Fraud and Prohibited Activity

Any attempt to artificially generate or manipulate referrals, clicks, orders, commissions, or other Affiliate Program activity is prohibited.

Prohibited conduct includes, but is not limited to, fraudulent orders, fake customer accounts, unauthorized self-referrals, cookie stuffing, forced clicks, misleading redirects, automated traffic, stolen payment information, unauthorized coupon distribution, commission manipulation, and other deceptive practices.

Just Like Kandy reserves the right to investigate suspicious Affiliate activity.

Commissions associated with fraudulent or prohibited activity may be withheld, canceled, or reversed, and the Affiliate may be immediately removed from the Program.

14. Termination

Either the Affiliate or Just Like Kandy may end the Affiliate's participation in the Program.

Just Like Kandy reserves the right to suspend or terminate an Affiliate account for reasons including, but not limited to, violation of these Terms, fraudulent activity, misleading advertising, unauthorized product claims, misuse of promotional codes, inappropriate use of Just Like Kandy intellectual property, conduct that could damage the brand's reputation, or other activity we reasonably determine to be inconsistent with the Program.

Upon termination, the Affiliate must discontinue use of Just Like Kandy Affiliate links, coupon codes, and promotional materials as directed.

Legitimate commissions earned from qualifying transactions before termination may remain payable, subject to verification and these Terms. Commissions associated with fraud, prohibited activity, or violations of these Terms may be forfeited where permitted by law.

15. Changes to the Affiliate Program

Just Like Kandy reserves the right to modify the Affiliate Program, including commission rates, cookie periods, promotional rules, eligibility requirements, available marketing resources, incentives, payment procedures, and other Program features.

When practical, Affiliates will be notified of material changes through the Affiliate portal, email, or another reasonable communication method.

Continued participation in the Program after updated Terms become effective constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

16. Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Just Like Kandy will not be responsible for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential losses arising from participation in the Affiliate Program.

Just Like Kandy is not responsible for lost commissions caused by circumstances outside our reasonable control, including tracking failures, browser privacy settings, deleted or blocked cookies, third-party platform outages, incorrect Affiliate payment information, or other technological issues that prevent a referral from being properly attributed.

Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability that cannot legally be excluded or limited.

17. Governing Law

These Terms and Conditions and participation in the Just Like Kandy Affiliate Program will be governed by applicable federal law and the laws of the State of North Carolina, without regard to conflict-of-law principles, except where applicable law requires otherwise.

Any dispute relating to the Affiliate Program will be handled in accordance with applicable law and any additional dispute-resolution terms adopted by Just Like Kandy.

18. Acceptance of Terms

By submitting an application, registering for, or participating in the Just Like Kandy Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms and Conditions.

You also acknowledge that participation in the Program does not guarantee sales, commissions, income, or continued acceptance into the Program.

If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions, you should not register for or participate in the Just Like Kandy Affiliate Program.

Questions regarding the Affiliate Program may be directed to Just Like Kandy using the contact information provided within the Affiliate portal.
